name: Khairt
description: A knight who, in Shanodin, returns to his true self as a wrestler from Oneah and a lover of beauty.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Oneah, goblins breach Xa-On and Ayesh hides beneath the Roof of Lights.
timeline.quote: Ayesh fearfully hid herself beneath the Roof of Lights in a concealed grate

timeline.summary: At the Heart of Shanodin, Daisilodavi kills Lord Glinham and the dryad; the two men nearly fight, then leave bonded.
timeline.quote: Daisilodavi has killed the dryad as well.

relations.quote: Sent by the king Amjad , the assassin Daisilodavi and the knight Khairt are heading for the Heart of Shanodin
